introduction: Bram works the fence line, and he has come all the way up to the trough to be fair to you. It has plainly cost him something. He would also rather nobody saw him doing it.
introductionSummary: Bram comes to be fair to you, wants no witnesses, and lets go of something on his way out that he does not think matters.

logicalFallacies.explanation: Answering the animal instead of the argument. That nobody knew Rue's name a month ago is not evidence about the pond.
Treating a count of who agrees as though it were a reason. Forty-one animals can all be repeating the same thing nobody checked.

sentences.text: Rue. A word, and I would rather you did not mention to anyone that I came and had it.
The Meadow-Born have settled it between them already. Forty-one of them have said yes, and you cannot have forty-one animals be wrong about their own water.

logicalFallacies.explanation: The number counts who agreed, not what any of them looked at. Forty-one animals repeating each other is one opinion, forty-one times.

sentences.text: Forty-one, Rue. That is not a mistake. That is a number.

logicalFallacies.explanation: Saying the number again makes it feel heavier without making it evidence. Size of crowd is still not a reason.

statement.summary: He arrives in secret and lays out the count as though counting were the same thing as checking.

sentences.text: And frankly the only one making a noise about any of this is the raccoon, and a month ago not one animal here knew your name.

logicalFallacies.explanation: How recently the farm learned Rue's name is a fact about Rue. It is offered as a reason to stop listening to him.

sentences.text: Sorry. Sorry, that came out badly, and I am not saying it because I am a wolf. Everyone I have asked says the same thing, that is all I meant.

logicalFallacies.explanation: Everyone he asked agreeing is a fact about who he asked. It is doing the work of a reason without being one.

sentences.text: The grate at the outflow is bent, mind. Been bent since before the frost. But that is a different thing and I would not bring it up on Sunday.

statement.summary: He apologises mid-insult, leans on the crowd instead, and lets go of the bent grate as though it were unrelated.
